displayName: Hawanama smoke outlook: high upwind fire load for tomorrow

documentation.content: The smoke outlook (task fires-outlook on hawanama-ingest) put at least one city in the high or very_high band for D+1: the fires seen in the last two days, carried forward, sit upwind of the city on the ECMWF 850 hPa wind and within a day's transport, with more than 1,000 MW of fire radiative power. It is a smoke-source outlook, not a PM2.5 forecast. See the log line for the cities, `GET /api/v1/fires/outlook` for the full picture, and hawanama.org/fires. Runbook: apps/api/app/services/fire_outlook.py.

conditions.displayName: smoke outlook D+1 high or very_high

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="hawanama-ingest" AND textPayload:"SMOKE OUTLOOK: D+1 high"
